title: Resolved star formation in the metal-poor star-forming region Magellanic Bridge C
question: How do molecular clumps, YSOs and PMS stars in the metal-poor Magellanic Bridge region MB-C compare with Galactic counterparts?

what.value: NANTEN I_CO of 140 mK km/s and X_CO 1.4e21 for the Bridge

evidence.quote: using the reported $I_{\text{CO}}$ of 140 mK km s$^{-1}$ by Mizuno et al. (2006)
The observed SEDs are fit against the Robitaille (2017) model grid of young stellar objects
we utilise the Bressan et al. (2012) single star isochrones and tracks

recipe.goal: Identify CO clumps and measure properties
recipe.method: CPROPS with modified CLUMPFIND (/ECLUMP) decomposition; moment method with sensitivity extrapolation and deconvolution
key_parameters: mask above 4 sigma_rms, edge threshold 2.0–1.5 sigma
assumptions: Virial mass for spherical cloud with 1/r density profile; distance 59 kpc

recipe.method: Least-squares fit of virial mass versus CO luminosity
Fit Spitzer+optical SEDs to Robitaille (2017) models; select model set by chi2<=chi_best+3
key_parameters: distance 59 kpc; A_V 0–20 mag; Weingartner & Draine SMC bar law; >=5 fluxes

recipe.goal: Identify accreting PMS stars and derive mass/age
recipe.method: r-Halpha excess gives EW; selection by Barrado y Navascues & Martin criteria; masses/ages from CMD with Bressan isochrones at 1/5 Zsun, A_V=0.5

evidence.quote: Twelve clumps in MB-C having signal-to-noise greater than 13 at the peak are detected.
Thus, 58 per cent of NANTEN observed luminosity is recovered by ALMA
The surface densities of these clumps range between 12–200 $M_{\odot}$pc$^{-2}$
We corrected for a mean absolute extinction $A_V$ of 0.5$\pm$0.07 mag
In total, eleven stars are selected on this basis.

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration/imaging steps (weighting, cleaning, masks)

score_reason: Public data and clear clump analysis but ALMA processing details missing.
